- Note: Reddit users hate obvious ads — be authentic

Measurement:
- Track: impressions, clicks, signups, cost per signup
- Attribution: UTM parameters on all links
- Goal: <$50 cost per signup (organic is free but slow)

Post-launch decision: If CPL < $30, increase budget. If > $80, pause and optimize.

notes.title: Newsletter Strategy
notes.content:
Newsletter Strategy — 'The Weekly Flow'

Name: The Weekly Flow (TechFlow AI's newsletter)
Frequency: Weekly (every Wednesday)
Audience: 12,000 waitlist subscribers + growing
Platform: Resend (migrating to Customer.io Q2)

Format:
1. Opening hook (1-2 sentences, current/timely)
2. Product update (new features, fixes, what's coming)
3. Productivity tip (AI-related, not just TechFlow)
4. Community spotlight (user win, feature request shipped)
5. One interesting link (AI news, productivity article)
6. CTA (try feature, share feedback, invite colleague)

Metrics targets:
- Open rate: 40%+ (current: 38%)
- Click rate: 15%+ (current: 12%)
- Growth: 500 new subscribers/month
- Unsubscribe: <0.5%/send

Growth tactics:
- Blog → newsletter CTA (every post)
- Product Hunt → newsletter signup (launch day)
- Social → newsletter (monthly promotion)
- Content upgrades (download PDF → email required)

Content rules:
- Never just sell — always provide value first
- Keep under 500 words (respect time)
- Mobile-first formatting (short paragraphs, bold key points)
- Send Wednesday 9am PT (highest open rate day/time for B2B)
- Personal tone — from 'Nina at TechFlow', not 'The TechFlow Team'
